[LFAC.9.3] **`ts` is read-only to authors.** An author may read `ts` wherever a
slot may be read, in patterns, expressions and test assertions, and must not
write it. The compiler must refuse a `ts` value supplied by a rule's `emit` or
`publish`, or by a test's constructed fact in `inputs`, `initial` or a response
reply ([LTSL.4.1]), with `DS_VALIDATE_TS_READ_ONLY`.
